Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "more.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "Error " & CStr(v)
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 60 Then
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function R0(ws As Object) As String
    Dim c As Object, s As String, v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set c = ws.Range("C2:C3")
    v = Empty
    v = c.FormulaLocal
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    v = Empty
    v = c.Formula
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    v = Empty
    v = c.HasFormula
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & "|e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        s = s & "|" & Show(v)
    End If
    R0 = Replace(s, "'" & ws.Name & "'!", "<sheet>!")
End Function

Public Function S0() As String
    Dim ws As Object, c As Object, e As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    ws.Range("B2").Value = 1
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 3
    Set c = ws.Range("C2:C3")
    On Error Resume Next
    c.FormulaLocal = "=1+1"
    e = Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    S0 = Replace("e" & e & R0(ws), wb.Name, "<book>")
End Function

    A0 = Replace(R0(wb.Worksheets(2)), wb.Name, "<book>")
